capabilities.description: Update optional MT5 native paths through the existing dependency command, concurrency and validation path; main conversation only.

outputSchema.description: Domain result: native responses retain explicit status/errors, actual identities, provenance and availability; command outputs depend on the selected declared operation.

usage.purpose: Forward shared configuration edits to the existing MT5 dependency authority.
usage.outputs: The original dependency settings and version, with the existing command receipt preserved.
prerequisites: Main conversation; the expected_version comes from dependencies.read or mt5_dependencies inspect.
limitations: Reuses the existing idempotency receipts and busy/path validation. Saving does not download dependencies or launch a terminal.
